summary: The spec's scenario has no task that tests it.

findings.title: No task covers an empty widgets/ directory
findings.body: tasks.md has one task with a test for two widgets, but nothing defines or tests what `widget list` does when `widgets/` is empty, so the implementation can pick any behavior.
findings.recommendation: Add a task (and a spec scenario) for an empty widgets/ directory: print nothing and exit 0.

next_steps: Cover the empty widgets/ directory in the spec and tasks.
